abilitySections.title: Dash Back
content: Begin Phasing for 2 seconds. Phasing won't activate if Ghost is afflicted with an Armor Break Debuff or has a Precision Passive.

abilitySections.title: Phasing
content: While Phasing, incoming attacks have a 100% chance to Miss and each Damage Over Time Debuff on Ghost converts to a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [4,427] for 5 seconds.
Psychic attacks will not Miss Ghost, even while she is Phased.
Upon Phasing, gain a Precision Passive for 6 seconds which guarantees the next hit to be Critical and consumes the Precision Passive. Ghost can only land Critical Hits through her abilities.
While this Precision is active, Opponents cannot trigger their Evade abilities.
Phasing is immediately deactivated when Ghost initiates an attack or Blocks an attack.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Non-Critical Hits have a 10% chance to gain a Cruelty Buff increasing Critical Damage Rating by [1,500] for 20 seconds. Cruelty Buffs stack up to 5.
When the opponent Evades, gain a Precision Passive for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 50% chance to gain a Fury Buff for 10 seconds, granting +[2,213.5] Attack.
The chance to gain a Cruelty Buff on a Heavy Non-Critical Hit increases the longer the Heavy Attack is charged.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: When triggered immediately upon Phasing, each hit is a guaranteed Critical, and Opponents cannot trigger their Evade abilities.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Gain a Cruelty Buff increasing Critical Damage Rating by [1,500] for 20 seconds, then refresh all Cruelty Buffs generated by Ghost.
When triggered immediately upon Phasing, each hit is a guaranteed Critical, and Opponents cannot trigger their Evade abilities.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Each Cruelty Buff generated by Ghost converts to a permanent Cruelty Passive. Cruelty Passives stack up to 5.
